decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core practice software with clear links to compliance, patient workflows and the firm’s existing development knowledge, it is a product we can improve and commercialise effectively.

The education institute builds on our training content and customer relationships, so despite being somewhat more service-oriented than software, it remains related enough to our knowledge base to justify continuation.
Remote screen sharing support strongly complements our installed software base and support capabilities, making it easy for us to absorb feedback and integrate it into customer service improvements.
A practice analytics dashboard fits our software, data and workflow expertise well, and our in-house R&D gives us the capacity to learn from early use and refine it further.
The complete dental practice bundle is very close to our established offer and leverages our modular product range and integration capabilities, so it is highly likely to remain on the market.

A job and practice listing portal is relatively distant from our core software and support knowledge, so our absorptive capacity is weaker here and the resources are more likely to be redeployed to more related products.
